observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: television studio stage with backdrop featuring geometric patterns and text branding
observation.dancers: six dancers, mixed group of men and women
observation.formation_and_space: line formation moving horizontally and rotating in place
observation.posture: upright torso, relaxed knees, weight shifting side to side
observation.footwork: step-touch and light stepping matching the rhythmic feel
observation.arms_and_hands: arms bent at elbows, hands making fluid waving and swirling gestures
observation.hips_and_torso: minimal torso twists and hip movement following the arm gestures
observation.levels_jumps_turns: standing level, occasional small pivots and turns
observation.costume_and_props: women wear pink dresses with wide dark belts, elaborate feather headpieces; men wear blue sheer jackets over yellow shirts, red sashes, dark trousers, and red top hats
